draw_direction: Favor Item finding/revealing and Item recovery/recycling over generic draw. User references Oswald and Tamatoa; individual draw abilities must be revisited.

timing_clarifications.P093: Per-copy stacking locked October 10: each eligible Inventor may resolve discovery once during your turn from the same Dismiss, revealing sequential top cards. Entering Rotated still triggers entry abilities. If a qualifying Item is revealed but free play is declined or illegal, put it on the bottom; never leave a revealed card unresolved. The trigger counts as used even on a miss.
timing_clarifications.P092: Per-copy stacking locked October 10: each eligible Trans Am may recover one actual face-up Item spent from your own Stash as payment and still in your discard. Cash In the Clutter does not spend Stash. If multiple Items are spent simultaneously, choose one for each eligible copy; no actual card can be returned twice. Fully resolve payment before recovery.
timing_clarifications.P095: Nonstacking Hoarder discount locked October 10: at most 1 cost reduction from all Hoarders combined on the first Item played during your turn. Cost/stats and entry recovery remain draft values for individual review.
timing_clarifications.Scurry Away: Superseding keyword locked October 10: opposing Character Trouble only, not general Composure loss. Multiple Characters may each actually return from play to hand to reduce the same event by 1 each, minimum zero. No Ready/Rotated requirement. No generic response window. Include at least one 1-cost pest during card review; precise assignments remain to review. Original Possum Defeat/Item-Dismiss recovery is banked as possible explicit card text, no longer the keyword.
timing_clarifications.Trouble protection: October 12 superseding Cart lock: immediately Dismiss on activation, apply -2 Trouble to chosen opposing Character until start of controller's next turn. Multiple debuffs stack; effective Trouble minimum zero. Zero Trouble cannot Cause Trouble, including final Last Straw hit. No armed Item or next-event shield. Scurry Away retains its separate locked return-triggered reduction.
timing_clarifications.P108: Counts all actual friendly Item Dismissals during the current turn, including before this Character entered play. Scrap replacement preserves the Dismiss count. Spending or moving cards out of Stash, returning Items to hand, and attachment cleanup do not count. Trouble bonus resets at turn end; no cap specified. Standard Character entry restrictions apply. Supersedes recycling/healing and original draw/healing entry proposals.
timing_clarifications.scrap_leader: Supersedes keyword and selected-Item-only eligibility. Only Trash Baron grants broad salvage from play to own discard; any qualifying Item may use it, including non-Salvage Items in legal decks. Stash spending does not re-salvage. Zip Ties/Sandwich no longer excluded. Trash Collector explicit discard-to-Stash entry effect is a confirmed intentional cross-Leader exception, approved October 12.
timing_clarifications.P107: Normal free replay from discard with no expiry/one-use marker. Enter normally and resolve entrance effects. Supersedes temporary end-turn Dismiss.
timing_clarifications.Junk Heap: One Item chooses one replacement destination (leader Stash, heap storage or discard). Only capture an Item you control going from play to your discard, maximum five per Heap. Stored cards are face-up/public and not in play. Stored-card cleanup when Heap leaves is not Dismiss and cannot re-salvage. Standard entry restrictions apply even if assembled on entry turn. No final five-Item bonus.
